Final Room of the Family Hierarch Evaluation
家主评审 最终房间

dataList.content:
Jia Qiu was waiting for us, just as Hong Lu had predicted.
和鸿璐猜测的一样，贾丘正在那里等着我们。

We couldn't tell how long he'd been waiting for us in here, as he didn't appear to be even remotely tired or angry.
虽不知他等了多久。但他脸上既无疲惫，也无愤怒……

He only regarded us in that same, collected silence we remember seeing from the day we first met.
只是带着与初次见面时别无二致的表情，静静注视着到来的我们。

How nice of them to bring us all together.
多么亲切啊。

Isn't their intent quite obvious? Gathering all of us in here...
居然特地把剩下的人叫到一起面对面……

... They're telling us to rid ourselves of the trouble of finding each other, and determine who comes first among us.
这是打算让我们省下互相寻找的功夫，直接竞争出第一名吗？

Still your insolent tongue, Jia Huan. You possess not even an inkling of the path ahead.
前途未卜，不要轻易开口，贾环。

You have taken that name for a better purpose than to assume such a boorish display of vanity, have you not?
你被冠以此名，并非是为了肩负这般不知轻重的傲慢吧。

The tension was palpable. No one was going to make the first move.
没有人敢轻举妄动。

There was Jia Huan, who's always been hostile toward Hong Lu and us.
贾环一直以来都对鸿璐和我们抱有强烈敌意。

Then there was Jia Qiu, whose innermost thoughts we couldn't hope to grasp... but most likely harbored much anger toward Hong Lu and carried the torch of vengeance for his family's destruction.
以及贾丘，虽然不知道他脑中所想，但他或许仍然带有对鸿璐的愤怒，以及因自己家族被灭门而产生的复仇心。

Look, there's... something written up there.
那里……好像写着什么……

Ishmael whispered.
以实玛利轻声说道。

A question, written in large, red letters.
房间内刻着红色的大字。

‘State the virtue of the Family Hierarch.’
“何为家主必备之品德”

Now, we have the top three candidates all gathered in this room. Are we about to find out the winner of this game right here, right now, right in this room?
目前第一到三名。三位候选人齐聚一堂。也许不久后就能在这房间内决出第一了。

So... with the gravity of this particular situation clearly communicated... let's try something completely different this time. Different, but most appropriate for the ceremony of selecting the next Hierarch of Hongyuan.
因此……在这里准备了不同于以往的全新活动。既然要成为家主，那么至少要对鸿园进行一次自我展示吧。

Behold the wall and ponder the question! This is the time for our finalists to debate the very question at the core of the Family Hierarch Evaluation!
挂在墙上的问题，是贯穿整个家主评审根源的一问，对此我们为最后的候选人们提供自由交谈的时间！

We are to... engage in a dialogue?
……是让我们彼此交涉么？

Hilarious. Had enough of the bloodshed, then? Shall we end this game with a sophisticated little confabulation on the sanctimonious ‘virtues’ instead? Might as well put a bow on it, why don't you?
真好笑。是因为见腻了血，所以想靠高尚的对话做出了断吗？

If the opponent accepts your argument... perhaps you could indeed flex your rhetorical muscles and finish the second round with a parlay of words... But wouldn't you like to know what happens if you can't?
如果能说服彼此……也可能仅凭对话就结束第二轮家主评审……可如果你们不能认同彼此呢？

It changes absolutely nothing! Simply return to what you've been doing for this entire event! Take or be taken! Grab as many coins as you can!
那就毫无变化！只需和以往一样，继续这争夺不休的铜钱抢夺战即可！

But all of this was but the host's 'suggestion', nothing more.
不过，那终究只是主持人字面上的建议……

If either Jia Qiu or Jia Huan decides to just attack us anyway, we'd have no choice but to fight them.
如果贾丘或是贾环选择了淘汰其他人，我们也不得不采取相应的对策。

<What now...?>
<现在该怎么办……>

However, Jia Qiu...
然而，贾丘依然……

... only wordlessly gazed up at the writings on the wall.
只是默默看着墙上那行意义不明的文字。

What now, brothers?
现在怎么办，诸位兄长？

Hong Lu asked casually.
鸿璐神色自若地询问。

I have to start thinking about every permutation of events that could happen this moment onward.
同时，我脑海中浮现出诸多可能性。

What if he decides to ally with Jia Huan to take us out? Wait, no. Someone like Jia Qiu might not even have to ally with anyone to destroy us.
如果对方决定和贾环联手，优先除掉我们该怎么办？不，像贾丘那样实力超群的人，即便不结盟应该也能压制我们吧。

Which means that, for us to come second, at least one of them must be eliminated.
也就是说，为了成为第二名，我们起码要淘汰其中一人才行。

There is a possibility that forfeiting the game now could result in us placing third.
如果现在弃权，也许可以争取第三名。

However, what must also be considered is that, outside this room, there are other candidates who have collected a similar number of coins as we have; it is possible that there are additional coins to be collected, the sum of which may be greater than our current sum.
不过。若是这房间外存在和我们所持铜钱数量相近的候选人，他们的争斗也有可能改变排名……

... A small variable, but a risk nonetheless.
微小的变数也不能忽视。

... Yeah, but the biggest problem right now is that the only other clan that's aware of the Golden Bough... currently ranks higher than we do.
……最大的问题是，知道金枝存在的势力……目前排在我们之上。

Not only are they aware of it, it's probably the whole reason they're participating in this game. At this point, they might as well have already obtained it if they were to forfeit now.
不仅仅是知道吧？哪怕贾环像那时一样抢走金枝也不奇怪。更何况他们怎么可能会放过不必流血就能拿走金枝的机会。

The ideal scenario would be for Jia Qiu to utterly destroy the N Corp. forces, take all of their coins, and eliminate them from the game. But...
最好的情况或许是……N公司的那家伙的铜钱被贾丘全部抢走，就此落选……

Dammit, I can't strategize without knowing what he's thinking. He is impenetrable.
妈的……搞不明白他的想法，根本无法制定计划。

Outis, of all people, appeared completely stumped... This certainly does not bode well for our plan.
奥提斯叹气的含义很明显。作战已经接近失败了。

That big fella... he's not much of a talker, and seems to be the kind of guy who prefers to destroy his way to success than to talk things out...
那位老兄，话也不多……我感觉他比起玩这种过家家，可能更想把一切都破坏掉……

They have given us a platform to parlay. Thus rightly parlay we shall.
既然设置了场所，那便有继续交谈的道理。

What Jia Qiu said was a surprise to all of us.
贾丘说出了我们不曾想象的话。

Now that's unexpected. You're going to play along with this meaningless game, Jia Qiu?
真让人意外？你打算接受这种无聊的游戏吗，贾丘？

The long years spent away from Hongyuan must've been quite smooth-sailing for you.
看样子在渺无音讯的那漫长岁月里，你过得很惬意啊。

There was loneliness and impecuniosity, but it was indeed smooth-sailing.
虽穷困孤苦，但也舒心惬意。

I was deprived of those who would stand with me, for I was wanting in the fortune with matters of people; thus, I sought out the new, embraced them, and learned much.
我缺乏仁德，身边才无一人留存，因此我只是亲身行动，拥抱新事物，从中学习而已。

I don't know just who you could've possibly met and learned from out there, but... your ambitions have certainly inflated.
虽然我不知道你见了谁，又积累了些什么……不过野心倒是大了不少。

I met this Zhao of the Wang family on my way here...
来这里的路上，我碰到了那个王家的王照……

And he, whom we had all known to be quite clever, was sitting alone without coins, waiting for his elimination to be confirmed.
那个众所周知的聪明人，为什么一枚铜钱都没有，分文不剩地落选了呢。

And do you know what he said to me then?
我提问后，王家那家伙是这么说的……

That he'd already given all of his coins to the one who should have them.
他把自己的铜钱全都交给了相配的人。

That he'd already achieved 'his' victory in this game, as he'd already given his coins to the one who deserves them most before anyone who does not could claim them...
他还说，既然在被不相配的人拿走之前，将其交给了正确的人，自己就已经等同于赢得了家主之争……

I was tickled by that insolence, so I thought to separate his head from his torso... but the Heishou of this evaluation site leaped in to protect him.
他说的话太过放肆，我本想把他的脑袋砍掉……可是被考场的黑兽给阻止了。

Jia Qiu, why would you seek the Wang family's alliance now, of all times?
为什么事到如今才开始拉拢王家，贾丘。

Alliance? Quite the lofty phrasing for what that was.
说拉拢未免太过夸张。

I had merely discerned what he deemed to be good—and promised that I would make it so.
我不过是看清了他认为有利之事，并给予了他有利之处。

What is good, huh...
利吗……

What could you possibly have, after having essentially severed yourself from Daguanyuan for years, to offer him that the Wang family doesn't already have?
我很好奇几乎和大观园断绝关系的你……到底能给王家什么利益。

Fine, then... I'll play along with your game for now. If you have something to say, then say it.
算了……就陪你们玩玩吧。想说什么何不趁现在说呢。

Jia Huan gave Jia Qiu a sarcastic grin as he leaned against the wall.
贾环嗤笑一声，靠在墙上看着贾丘。

To ask one to state the virtue of the Family Hierarch...
家主必备之品德……

... is to ask one to state what it is that Hongyuan, soon to be under the lordship of the new Hierarch, needs the most.
换言之，或是意指家主在治理鸿园时所必需的东西。

I saw naught but two kinds of people as I was raised in this vast yet confined room they call Hongyuan.
我在这名为鸿园的巨大屋室中成长至今，唯能目睹两件事。

Those who kill, and those who die.
杀人与被杀。

To dissolve this vile distinction, to restore to the righteous path this land's trajectory of history, dyed crimson with the blood spilled in the name of our selfish avarice... we need these two virtues: humanity and propriety.
为了破坏这一区别，让顺从自身欲望互相伤害的历史回归原状……则需要“仁”与“礼”。

Your words are utterly meaningless. Do you seriously think the people who clamber around every Restructuring Day to secure just enough room for them to live have any care left to give about either of your pretentious virtues?
虚无缥缈的空话。你觉得对一到重构日就得拼命守护自己那一间房间的人而言，说这些有用吗？

What Hongyuan needs is simple and pragmatic: the power to dominate and the administrative efficacy to wield it. Not to mention the ability to maintain the constant upward growth of technological innovation to keep up with the other Wings.
鸿园所需要的，是强大的力量与卓越的行政。非要再说一点，那就是不落后于其他翼的新技术吧。

Unlike the other two who seemed to be more engaged in this debate than I'd expected...
两人提出的话题比想象中更为正式，而与此相对的……

... Hong Lu kept his aloof silence, as though none of that was of any interest to him.
鸿璐像是毫无兴趣一样，一言不发。

This seemed to irk Jia Qiu, who turned to look at Hong Lu.
也许是注意到这点……贾丘向鸿璐投去视线。

... Speak, Jia Baoyu.
……贾宝玉。

Dare speak your mind—what does Hongyuan need?
你也畅所欲言便是。鸿园最需要的是什么？

Don't treat him as though he's on the same scale on which we operate, Jia Qiu.
最好别用你的衡量标准对待他，贾丘。
He doesn't even know what he needs, let alone what Hongyuan needs. This is a waste of time. 对一个连现在的自己需要什么都不清楚的家伙，又怎么问他鸿园所需要的东西呢。

He does not even possess an ounce of ambition nor the heart to bloviate meaninglessly about his purposes.
那家伙连说些花言巧语的胆量都没有。

... Yes, brother Huan is right. How could someone like me even dream of participating in such a... grand discussion of great causes?
……没错。正如哥哥所说。这种……对大义的询问，我怎么能做出回答呢？

I will not formulate my judgment of you based on conclusions Jia Huan or anyone else in Hongyuan has drawn. They will be heard, indeed, but my Way is forged only by the answers that spring from my own deliberations.
我不准备根据贾环或是鸿园的其他人所下的结论来评判你。虽听取他人之言，但最后唯有亲自思索得到的答案，才能成为自身之道。

Thus, Jia Baoyu—do not allow the judgment of others to guide your tongue.
所以贾宝玉。你的答案也无需顺应他人的结论。

Jia Qiu replies sternly. Hong Lu looks toward the ground, somewhat taken aback, before looking up at Jia Qiu.
贾丘斩钉截铁地说道。而鸿璐面露难色地看向地面，最后再次注视着贾丘。

Would it not be much more... productive for you to tell us more of your thoughts, big brother?
不如请大哥就自己的想法……更详细地谈谈，这样不是更好吗？

Hah... just listen to him.
哈啊……你看。

To reply to my lord's question with such a fatuous query signifies that he lacks the vision to perceive the grand picture.
在这种情况下反问，是不理解大局的表现。

Oi... This ain't the kind of question you can just pop out an answer for, is it? Don't put 'im on the spot, give him some time to—!
喂……你觉得答案是能啪一下冒出来的吗？再给点时间啊……！

Do you still fail to realize which party among those present wields the sharpest blade?
此时此刻手握主导权的是谁？

Shame that you do not understand the significance of the powerful choosing to engage in rhetoric over crushing others with sheer might in times of chaos...
在乱世中强者不选择以武力征服他人而给予其机会，可你们甚至不清楚其中含义……令人叹息。

That is enough, Zilu.
子路啊，够了。

I ask you again. What virtue must the Hierarch possess? What does Hongyuan need the most?
再问你一次。关于家主必备之物，如今鸿园最所需之物，你有何答案。

... For a split second, Hong Lu's lips part.
……鸿璐的嘴似乎微张了片刻。

dataList.content:
But they soon shut again, as though he was shaking himself from an illusion.
可那一切又像是我的错觉一样，鸿璐屏息闭上了嘴。

Honestly, I have no idea what kind of answer you're looking for from me, brother.
我不清楚，大哥希望我做出怎样的回答。

This was my first act of goodwill toward you… and quite possibly, the final opportunity I may be able to afford you.
这是我第一次对你施以善意……同时也是最后一次机会。

Will you discard it regardless, blinded to its significance?
而你不知其宝贵，仅仅想将其浪费。

Brother Qiu...
大哥……

You must be anticipating something from me.
你一定对我有所期待吧。

Anticipation, is it...
期待……

An imprudent anticipation begets nothing but despair in the face of futility, leaving nothing but a hollow heart in its wake.
错付的期待，到最后只会留下虚幻而空虚的心境。

Even still... I have deigned to grant you my valuable time for that slim potentiality I once saw within you.
即使如此……我也寄希望于从你身上所见的那一丝可能性，抽出了宝贵的时间。

And by doing so, I risk delaying everything that I have prepared for a long, long time.
甚至承担起长久以来准备的一切都将滞后的风险。

Yet... you still evade my every query.
而你……只是在回避对我做出答案。

To swallow one's words when it is their turn to speak is to hide them.
于讲述之时，却闭口不言应说之事，这即为隐瞒。

As you insist on stopping and veiling your thoughts, I am, perforce, compelled to act in a manner unbecoming of a noble man.
你一再放弃思考，试图隐瞒，我也难尽君子之道。

It seems that I must dabble in your methods today, Zilu.
子路啊。今日就借你的办法一用。

As you command, my lord.
谨遵主公之命。

I shall afford you neither the wherewithal nor the time to mask your ruminations.
唯有将你逼迫到无暇隐瞒思绪。

Bring forth a real answer; do not let it languish behind your tongue.
方能想得答案，脱口而出。
